description: What the model adapter suite must notice about the ready-made providers: a preset aimed at the wrong address, protocol, region or model, a key variable that is dropped or borrowed from another provider, a default that is a retired or deprecated model, a window written where the catalog answers, a caching claim for an endpoint that was not checked.

mutations.name: P1
mutations.what: the xAI preset loses the /v1 of its address

mutations.name: P2
mutations.what: the GLM preset is aimed at /v1 instead of the /v4 that Z.ai serves

mutations.name: P3
mutations.what: the GLM preset starts from an older model

mutations.name: P4
mutations.what: the Qwen preset is aimed at the Chinese region instead of the international one

mutations.name: P5
mutations.what: the MiniMax preset speaks Chat Completions to an address that serves the Messages API

mutations.name: P6
mutations.what: the MiniMax preset no longer accepts its key from the environment

mutations.name: P7
mutations.what: the xAI preset no longer accepts its key from the environment

mutations.name: P8
mutations.what: DeepSeek starts from the model it retired on 2026-07-24

mutations.name: P9
mutations.what: OpenAI Chat Completions starts from the deprecated gpt-5-mini

mutations.name: P10
mutations.what: OpenAI Responses starts from the deprecated gpt-5-mini

mutations.name: P11
mutations.what: the MiniMax preset claims that its endpoint accepts cache_control

mutations.name: P12
mutations.what: DeepSeek writes a context window of its own again

mutations.name: P13
mutations.what: the Z.ai key is also taken from the variable of another provider
